fields.name: stop
fields.label: Stop
fields.description: The stop or station's MBTA id, from the address of its page on mbta.com/stops: place-pktrm is Park Street, and a bus stop is its number (1123). Several with commas. A name of your own goes before an equals sign: Home = 1123.

fields.name: stop2
fields.label: Second stop
fields.description: Optional: another stop, shown beside the first, written the same way.

fields.name: walk
fields.label: Walk to the stop (minutes)
fields.description: Departures sooner than this are left out: you would not make them.

fields.name: only
fields.label: Only these lines
fields.description: Optional: line names as the board shows them, with commas.

options.label: Auto: high contrast where the panel shows no color

transitBoard.name: Transit departures (Boston, USA)
transitBoard.description: MBTA departures in Boston from the MBTA's own API (no key), as a station board for one or two stops.
